column1: # render's markup: reading of legacy named references
# (Replikanti/interviewscam#64): a built page that holds '&', a name of
# LEGACY_REFERENCES and then an ASCII letter, digit or '=' is not read
# (parse_render_page sets page.legacy_refs, foreign_markup_problems turns
# each entry into a markup: finding), because html.parser before Python
# 3.14 decodes such a reference in an attribute value and the browser
# keeps it as text: content="Avery Exampleton&eacutex. ..." holds the
# persona name as a whole word to the browser and not to html.parser
# (render rule 4, D10). One finding per name and page, with the first
# spelling (count/ rows); COUNT=1 on count/one proves that a page that is
# not read adds no other finding. The reader rows carry no COUNT=, because
# Python 3.14 reads the page as the browser does and also reports rule 4.
# On a copy of render/pass-persona-label (search_cases_runner in
# tools/selftest.sh, label render-legacyref). Columns: name, file, find
# (exactly one occurrence), replace, expect (PASS, COUNT=<n> <text>, or a
# text the findings must hold).
